entry.title: New: dsh-trilium
entry.summary: Connect Trilium notes to the DSH agent via ETAPI with 20 agent tools: durable memory (remember/recall + auto-injected index), note management (CRUD/clone/attributes/revisions), full-text search, weekly-report workflow, attachments, calendar notes, backup/import, and a settings card. Exact install spec: dsh-trilium. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
